title: Operations Control + Exception Dashboard
businessRequirement: Build a consolidated Operations Control + Exception Dashboard using approved ANCLINE data to surface action-required jobs, cut-off risks, document gaps, payment/release blocks, failed integration events, milestone delays, and reconciliation exceptions, with direct links to the relevant job/action. Preserve current workflows and the frozen accepted runtime baseline.
objective: Give internal operations a single control-tower surface for prioritized exceptions and direct remediation without changing underlying booking, finance, document, payment, release, NVOCC, or Forwarding business rules.

impactAssessment.web: REQUIRED — evolve the existing Exceptions & Action Board into the consolidated Operations Control dashboard and add direct action links while preserving WorkspaceShell/navigation conventions.
impactAssessment.api: REQUIRED — add/read-only aggregated operations-control data endpoint(s) so the dashboard can consume scoped exception data efficiently and consistently instead of duplicating business logic in the browser.
impactAssessment.shared: REQUIRED — dashboard UI and aggregation logic span Web and API; classify as SHARED.
impactAssessment.dataMigration: NOT_REQUIRED — use existing approved data models/events; no schema change planned.
impactAssessment.securityPrivacy: REQUIRED — internal-only scoped aggregation; customer/agent/shipper privacy boundaries must remain unchanged.
impactAssessment.financeReleaseControls: READ_ONLY — surface existing payment/release/reconciliation blockers only; do not alter release-security or payment rules.

regressionPlan.rule: SHARED staging gate approved by user. Require Web/API build, role/privacy browser UAT, responsive/failure/accessibility checks, full transaction lifecycle, and concurrency/idempotency/provider/payment/security regression before any later production decision.

approvedBy: User command: CR-20260923-001 staging-only deployment + full shared regression UAT
notes: Staging-only deployment approved after PR #6 merge. Production promotion remains explicitly disallowed. Preserve frozen UI/workflows, deploy only ancline-web-live and ancline-api-staging candidate runtimes, and require automatic rollback on failure. CR-20260923-002 is preserved unchanged in request history and may resume after this CR-001 staging gate.

nonGoals: No customer data exposure to carriers or external roles

acceptanceCriteria: One dashboard shows all requested exception categories from existing approved data.
Every actionable exception links to the correct job or remediation surface.
Severity and category counts reconcile with source records.
No duplicate exception rows for the same source event/object condition.
Role scope prevents external roles from seeing internal operational data.
Forwarding and NVOCC records remain correctly separated where controls differ.
Desktop, tablet, and mobile show no uncontrolled overflow/cutoff.
All mandatory SHARED regression scopes pass before promotion.
